limits: Isolated placement on actual authored maps; full HP/MP plus two small potions each at sequence start. Same source save per class/encounter, not a human win rate.
Starter keeps legal initial weapon, zero allocated stats; optimized reallocates already spent points and owned gear only. Production XP/loot/level healing remain enabled.
Commit policy intentionally ignores tells. Groups retain resources/cooldowns between maps. Three seeds diagnose mechanics, not statistical assurance.
